refnamediv.refpurpose: Network Mapper Graphical Topology, GeoIP, and Security Diff Display

refsect1.title: DESCRIPTION
refsect1.para: NastyMap is an interactive network topology visualization, geolocation mapping, and security comparison tool for Nmap XML output. It translates Nmap port scans, OS detection, service versioning, and traceroute hops into aesthetic, high-performance 2D dynamic physics graphs, hierarchical route trees, concentric radial diagrams, and global GeoIP vector maps.
NastyMap operates in both an interactive web/desktop GUI mode and a non-interactive headless command-line export mode suitable for automated security reports, CI/CD pipelines, and web dashboards.

listitem.para: Load and parse the specified Nmap XML scan output file.
Perform a visual security comparison between two Nmap XML scans, highlighting newly discovered hosts, removed nodes, opened ports/backdoors, and service changes.
Select the default network topology layout algorithm. Defaults to force.
Render the network topology graph to a vector SVG image and exit.
Render the network topology graph to a high-resolution PNG image and exit.
Generate a complete, self-contained HTML vulnerability and topology report with embedded interactive SVG map and host inventory.
Filter graph visualization to hosts with specified open ports (e.g. 22,80,443).
Filter graph visualization to hosts matching the specified OS family (e.g. Linux, Windows, Cisco).
Print a summary of command-line usage and exit.

refsect1.title: PARALLEL TRACEROUTE AND TOPOLOGY
refsect1.para: NastyMap leverages Nmap parallel traceroute data (--traceroute) to reconstruct intermediate router hops and latency metrics. Intermediate gateway nodes are deduplicated across targets, creating a unified topological graph of the network backbone from the scanner origin to end systems.

refsect1.title: GEOLOCATION MAPPING
refsect1.para: Public IP addresses discovered during perimeter scans are geocoded and displayed on an interactive vector world map with flight paths illustrating latency and packet hops.

refsect1.title: AUTHORS
refsect1.para: NastyMap was created for the Nmap Security Scanner community. Based on the Nmap Graphical Display GSoC initiative.
